revisionNote: Commits after runtimeCommit add only QA, preservation checks, handoff documentation and evidence. The containing report commit is not a new gameplay build.

implementation.sizeDefinition: For one enemy barrage bitmap, the longest displayed axis-aligned bound is no more than 20 percent of the shortest visible battle-canvas side, including CSS/backing scale, camera transform and bitmap rotation. This is not an area percentage.
sizeScope: native owner-specific flying ordnance including RC43 bloodied transits
implementation.visualPolicy: Only oversize images are shrunk. Aspect ratio, transparency and draw center are preserved. Damage, original collision geometry and flight velocity are not rescaled. The total length of decorative trails is not separately clipped.
implementation.melee: Native basic melee attacks are tagged at spawn, drawn at the locked impact point, and fade out at the end of a bounded 0.18-0.65 second display lifetime. Native EXIT eligible and canTransfer paths reject melee decals. Boss telegraph/area/coverage effects are not misclassified as basic melee.

movement.policy: Existing RC127 maximum-777-reference basic movement retained and verified in actual game state; collision, scripted control locks and blink remain separate mechanics.

audio.alliedAttackRouting: Original hero/action-specific attack sound routing preserved; optional reviewed mapping supported.
audio.genderPolicy: No unreviewed hurt voice is assigned. Existing contact-kinetic/contact-heavy effects are used until a reviewed per-hero identity and voice mapping is supplied. Unknown party member identity does not fall back to the active hero's gender.
audio.narration: Existing narration files, player and mixer are preserved byte-for-byte from starting main. Existing mute/unlock/voice limits remain authoritative.

preserved: RC129 named phases and dodge corridors
RC129 graze rewards and STORY/DREAM variation
RC127 dark jelly and defense conversion
STORY boss cooldown x2 and committed cast completion
existing narration and first/end audio timing

attachment.reason: The local container/Python execution service repeatedly returned ClientError, and the Files archive read provided no readable contents. Filenames, durations, voices and intended roles were not invented.
attachment.remainingWork: Obtain readable archive contents; review every actual audio file, assign verified hero/gender and attack/hurt/BGM roles, inspect onset/tail and clipping, then upload real binaries and a reviewed mapping.

core.melee: Three fixed-position ages, fade, finite retirement, no EXIT transfer and no HP mutation were verified per profile.
core.scope: Unit/stub assertions and staged native renderer cases are distinct from natural startup and the existing single first-region Story progression suite. These are not 27 complete natural campaigns.

legacy.preservation: Exact authorized RC130 edits were reapplied to pinned starting-main source in a disposable directory and compared byte-for-byte. Historical reference hashes are retained; the actual runtime under test was not replaced with old code.
legacy.countingNote: Legacy suites overlap the core regression set. Do not add 22 and 16 and call them 38 unique test cases.

firstAttempt.reason: HTTP 503 for existing data/story-rc51.js caused missing records data and a startup timeout.

public.retryInterpretation: The same code passed on retry without changing game files or relaxing assertions. The initial HTTP 503 remains in the failure history; this does not prove that future CDN/network failures are impossible.
public.archiveJobIssue: The original evidence job reused the first-attempt artifact name and branch, downloaded the older artifact, and encountered a non-fast-forward rejection. Do not confuse that archival failure with the successful second browser job.
public.scope: Read-only published bytes and three real startup/combat observations. No HTTP-response replacement, HP boost or progress injection. Not full campaigns or physical-device benchmarking.

limitations: No subjective listening review of the uploaded archive
No claim of every hero, map and mode completing a natural campaign
No physical iPhone/Safari or low-end Android performance certification
Occasional external HTTP failure was observed; no general CDN reliability guarantee
